description: About NCR VOYIX NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Quality Engineer to own and drive end-to-end quality assurance across a modern retail/POS platform built on React UI, Go-based services, BFF (Backend for Frontend), and distributed microservices architecture. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in automation testing, API validation, database verification, CI/CD quality governance, and retail transaction workflows. This role requires strong technical troubleshooting, defect isolation, and automation leadership to ensure high-quality releases across business-critical retail systems. Build and maintain robust Playwright-based end-to-end automation covering key POS workflows such as checkout, tender processing, receipts, order management, and lane/device interactions. Perform comprehensive testing of REST and gRPC APIs, including contract validation, negative-path testing, integration validation, and service-level quality verification. Validate distributed system behavior across React applications, BFF layers, and microservices, ensuring seamless end-to-end functionality. Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. Drive root cause analysis through detailed defect investigation using application logs, API traces, database evidence, and reproducible test scenarios. Advanced proficiency in SQL Server, including complex queries, joins, stored procedures, data validation, and test data analysis. Experience owning quality initiatives within CI/CD pipelines and release processes. Hands-on experience with Docker/Compose environments, service dependency troubleshooting, and containerized application testing. Demonstrated ability to create risk-based test plans aligned with business-critical workflows. Strong analytical, debugging, and defect isolation skills with evidence-driven problem-solving approaches. Experience validating distributed systems, microservices, and BFF architectures. Preferred Qualifications Experience in Retail, POS, Payments, Commerce, or Transaction Processing systems. Knowledge of POS device integration testing, including printers, scanners, payment terminals, and cash drawers. Understanding of security testing practices related to authentication, authorization, PII protection, and PCI compliance. Experience with observability and troubleshooting tools for distributed systems. Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to influence engineering teams and drive quality improvements across releases. title: Senior Software Engineer - POS / Payment Systems (Linux)
description: Valor PayTech fosters a vibrant and nurturing work atmosphere that motivates employees to innovate and excel. The culture is deeply rooted in collaboration and ongoing development, offering team members abundant opportunities for professional advancement and skill improvement. Emphasizing innovation excellence and cultural expansion, the company greatly values the diversity of its workforce, believing it to be a cornerstone of its success. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of software development experience to build secure, reliable payment applications on Linux-based POS terminals . The ideal candidate combines strong C on Linux with deep knowledge of ISO 8583, EMV transaction flows, Terminal Management Systems (TMS), and payment security . You will design, develop, integrate, debug, and maintain POS software from the payment kernel interface up to the terminal application, working closely with product, QA, and backend teams. What We Are Looking For A hands-on engineer who can work across the full Linux POS stack transaction processing, ISO 8583 messaging, device and peripheral integration, networking, and on-device debugging . You take ownership of complex low-level problems, drive solutions independently, and deliver secure, high-performance payment software on resource-constrained hardware. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain POS and payment applications for Linux-based payment terminals. Develop payment components, middleware, and services in C on Linux device. Implement and integrate third party libraries, ISO 8583 message formats, packing/unpacking, and host transaction flows. Integrate EMV L2 kernels , contact, contactless (NFC), and magstripe card flows with the terminal application. Work with Terminal Management Systems (TMS) for configuration, key and parameter loading, remote updates, and application deployment. Integrate vendor device SDKs and peripherals: card readers, PIN pads, thermal printers, modems, and displays over serial, USB. Build reliable host communication over TCP/IP, TLS (OpenSSL/mbedTLS), GPRS/4G, Wi-Fi, and Ethernet , with timeouts, reversals, and retry handling. Implement secure handling of keys, PINs, and card data in line with PCI PTS, PCI DSS, and P2PE requirements. Write multithreaded, memory-safe code using POSIX threads, IPC, sockets, and signals . Manage builds with GCC cross-compilation toolchains, Make, and CMake. Debug and perform root-cause analysis across application, middleware, kernel driver, and device layers using logs . Collaborate with backend teams on host interfaces, REST APIs, and transaction integration. Participate in code reviews and enforce coding standards. Write unit and integration tests and support QA and certification teams with defect resolution. Use Git for version control. Contribute to technical design, architecture decisions, documentation, and estimates. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and provide technical guidance to the team. Required Technical Skills POS & Payment Technologies Strong hands-on experience in POS / payment systems and POS transaction flows (sale, void, refund, pre-auth, reversal, settlement). Strong knowledge of ISO 8583 messaging and transaction processing. Working knowledge of EMV (contact and contactless) and card-scheme requirements. Experience with Terminal Management Systems (TMS) . Understanding payment security: DUKPT, Master/Session keys, HSM concepts, TR-31/TR-34 , and PCI standards is a plus. Linux & Systems Programming Expert-level C. Strong experience with Linux / embedded Linux application development. POSIX APIs: threads, mutexes, IPC, sockets, file I/O, signals is a plus. Cross-compilation with GCC/Clang toolchains, Make, CMake . Networking & Integration TCP/IP, TLS/SSL, OpenSSL Serial (RS-232), USB, and peripheral communication protocols. REST API and JSON integration; client-server error handling. Development Tools Git, Postman, Jira VS Code, Eclipse CDT, or NetBeans Software Engineering Skills Excellent debugging and troubleshooting on target hardware. Ability to work across application, payment, network, and device layers. Experience with the full SDLC, code reviews, testing, and release processes. Comfortable in a fast-paced product development environment. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, or a related field . 7+ years of professional software development experience. Previous experience in payment, banking, fintech, retail, POS, acquiring, or transaction-processing systems . Experience with Linux-based terminals from vendors such as PAX, Verifone, Newland, Ingenico, or Castles . Exposure to EMVCo, PCI PTS, or card-scheme certification cycles. Key Competencies POS & Payments | ISO 8583 | EMV | TMS | C | Embedded Linux | POSIX | Multithreading | Sockets | TCP/IP | TLS/OpenSSL | PCI / DUKPT | Device SDKs | Serial/USB | Make/CMake | Git | Postman | Debugging

title: Software Quality Engineer
description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. Role Overview We are looking for a passionate Quality Engineer with strong software development, automation, and AI skills. You will build frameworks, tools, and intelligent solutions that improve product testability, accelerate defect detection, and enable quality throughout the software development lifecycle. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for desktop, web, API, and system-level testing. Develop reusable software tools, libraries, APIs, and utilities that improve testability and engineering productivity. Partner with developers to review designs, improve code testability, and drive Shift-Left quality practices. Integrate automated validation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines. Apply AI and intelligent algorithms to generate tests, analyze logs, identify failure patterns, and accelerate root cause analysis. Automate the collection, transformation, and reporting of test results and quality metrics. Build actionable dashboards using Power BI or similar reporting tools. Support DevOps, continuous testing, and release-readiness initiatives. Required Skills And Qualifications Strong software development experience using C#, Java, Python, TypeScript, or a similar programming language. Strong understanding of OOP, OOD, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and clean coding practices. Experience developing automation frameworks, developer tools, APIs, libraries, or test infrastructure. Experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, WinAppDriver, or Coded UI. Experience with API testing frameworks such as RestAssured, Postman, SoapUI, JUnit, or TestNG. Knowledge of REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, SQL, Git, and web-service technologies. Experience integrating automated tests into Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD platforms. Hands-on exposure to Generative AI, AI-assisted coding, prompt engineering, LLM APIs, intelligent test generation, or log and failure analysis using AI. Strong debugging, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills. Good communication and collaboration skills. Minimum Qualifications Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years About KLA We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
